Hunter X Hunter summary:

From Viz: <br> Gon might be a country boy, but he has high aspirations. Despite his Aunt Mito&#039;s protests, Gon decides to follow in his father&#039;s footsteps and become a legendary Hunter. The Hunter hopefuls begin their journey by storm-tossed ship, where Gon meets Leorio and Kurapika, the only other applicants who aren&#039;t devastated by bouts of seasickness. Having survived the terrors of the high seas, Gon and his companions now have to prove their worth in a variety of tests in order to find the elusive Exam Hall.
